title: 第 8 课 · 电源大比较：电池 / 电源模块 / 稳压电源
summary: 三种常见电源各有什么特点？本课用面包板电源模块同时点亮上下两半。
concepts: breadboard power module 电源模块
description:
【1. 电池（battery）】
• 电压由化学决定：9V 方块电池、2/3/4 节 AA（3V / 4.5V / 6V）、CR2032 纽扣电池（3V）。
• 有内阻（internal resistance）：电流越大，端电压越低。9V 电池约 1.5Ω，AA 每节约 0.15Ω，CR2032 约 15Ω——纽扣电池只能带很小的负载。
• 没有任何保护：短路时会发热、迅速耗尽。
• 电池只有两根线，通常 + 接红轨、− 接蓝轨，只给一组轨道供电。

【2. 面包板电源模块（breadboard power module，如 MB102）】
• 插在面包板一端，跳线帽选择 5V 或 3.3V，用 USB 或 DC 插头取电。
• 它的针脚同时插进上、下两组电源轨：上下两组 + 轨都是 VCC，上下两组 − 轨都是 GND。所以本课上半区和下半区的 LED 都能直接从附近的轨道取电。
• 输出电流有限（约几百 mA），内阻很小，电压很稳。
• 插的时候注意方向：模块的 + 要对准红线轨道。

【3. 实验室直流稳压电源（bench power supply）】
• 电压可以连续调节（例如 0–30V）。
• 可以设定限流值（current limit）。正常时工作在 CV 恒压模式；一旦负载想要的电流超过限流值，自动切换到 CC 恒流模式，电压往下降，把电流卡在限流值——接错线、短路时它能保护电路。新手调试时建议把限流设小一点（如 50–100mA）。
• 用两根鳄鱼夹线接到面包板：红（+）接红轨，黑（COM / −）接蓝轨。和电池一样只接了一组轨道——如果下半区也要用电，需要自己用跳线把上下两组轨道连起来。

【无论哪种电源】
电源的 − 端就是电路的 GND（0V）。换电源不改变电路的结构，只改变电压和“能给多少电流”。

en.title: Lesson 8 · Power sources compared: battery / power module / bench supply
en.summary: What is each of the three common power sources like? This lesson uses a breadboard power module to light both the top and bottom halves.
en.description:
**1. Battery**
• The voltage is set by its chemistry: 9V block battery, 2/3/4 AA cells (3V / 4.5V / 6V), CR2032 coin cell (3V).
• It has internal resistance: the more current you draw, the lower the terminal voltage. A 9V battery has about 1.5Ω, each AA cell about 0.15Ω, a CR2032 about 15Ω, so a coin cell can only drive very small loads.
• No protection at all: on a short circuit it heats up and drains quickly.
• A battery has only two wires; usually + goes to the red rail and − to the blue rail, powering only one pair of rails.

**2. Breadboard power module (e.g. MB102)**
• Plugs into one end of the breadboard; a jumper cap selects 5V or 3.3V; powered from USB or a DC barrel jack.
• Its pins go into both the top and bottom pairs of rails at once: both + rails are VCC and both − rails are GND. That is why, in this lesson, LEDs in both the top and bottom halves can take power straight from the nearest rail.
• Limited output current (a few hundred mA), very low internal resistance, very stable voltage.
• Mind the orientation when plugging it in: the module's + must line up with the red-line rail.

**3. Lab DC bench power supply**
• The voltage is continuously adjustable (for example 0–30V).
• You can set a current limit. Normally it runs in CV (constant voltage) mode; as soon as the load tries to draw more than the current limit, it automatically switches to CC (constant current) mode and lowers the voltage to hold the current at the limit. This protects the circuit if you wire something wrong or short it. When debugging as a beginner, set the limit low (e.g. 50–100mA).
• It connects to the breadboard with two alligator-clip leads: red (+) to the red rail, black (COM / −) to the blue rail. Like a battery, it powers only one pair of rails; if the bottom half needs power too, you must join the top and bottom rails yourself with jumpers.

**Whatever the source**
The supply's − terminal is the circuit's GND (0V). Changing the power source does not change the structure of the circuit, only the voltage and "how much current it can deliver".
steps: Plug the 5V power module into column 1. Look: its four pins go into tp1, tn1, bp1 and bn1, so the top and bottom rails are powered at the same time.
Top half: R1 goes from the top red rail at tp6 to b6.
Yellow LED1 long lead c6, short lead c9; blue jumper a9 → tn9.
Bottom half: R2 goes from the bottom red rail at bp6 to j6. The bottom rails are powered by the same power module.
Green LED2 long lead i6, short lead i9; blue jumper j9 → bn9 (bottom − rail).
Both LEDs are on. Think about it: if you used a battery connected only to the top rails, would LED2 in the bottom half still light? (No: you would need jumpers to connect tp↔bp and tn↔bn.)
hints: The power module powers both the top and bottom rails; a battery or bench supply connects to only one pair, and you have to jumper the other pair yourself.
tests: Top and bottom LEDs both on, module output about 5V

tests.name: 上下两个 LED 都亮，模块输出约 5V

steps.text: 把 5V 电源模块插在第 1 列。看：它的四根针分别进入 tp1、tn1、bp1、bn1——上下两组轨道同时有电。
上半区：R1 从上方红轨 tp6 接到 b6。
黄色 LED1 长脚 c6、短脚 c9；蓝色跳线 a9 → tn9。
下半区：R2 从下方红轨 bp6 接到 j6。下方轨道的电也来自同一个电源模块。
绿色 LED2 长脚 i6、短脚 i9；蓝色跳线 j9 → bn9（下方 − 轨）。
两个 LED 都亮了。想一想：如果换成电池只接在上方轨道，下半区的 LED2 还会亮吗？（不会——需要用跳线把 tp↔bp、tn↔bn 连起来。）

hints: 电源模块同时给上下两组轨道供电；电池和稳压电源只接一组，另一组要自己用跳线连。
